the TP53 Pro72 and MDM-2 SNPs 285-309 are not associated with cancer risk, but that the MDM-2 SNP 309 is associated with an increased risk of cancer, and this risk is enhanced in the presence of the TP53 Pro 72 allele.
MDM2 SNP 309 is a cancer risk allele, but its role in cancer predisposition is still controversial and needs further investigations in order to be fully elucidated.

the MDM2 promoter SNPs (SNP309 and SNP285) are not only involved in the regulation of MDM2 expression, but also play a role in the susceptibility to cancer in LFS.
the MDM2 polymorphisms, in particular the SNP309, may be useful to identify a group of LFS Suggestivs patients with a higher risk of developing tumours.

MDM2 SNP is a risk factor for cancer in LFS patients and that it is a useful marker for the identification of individuals at high risk of developing cancer.
the MDM2 SNPs 285 and 309 are not associated with the risk of developing a LFS suggestive phenotype, but they may contribute to cancer susceptibility in LFS patients.
